name: UNION biometrics Co., Ltd.
summary: UNION COMMUNITY Co., Ltd. primarily manufactures equipment utilizing bio-recognition technology. Its extensive product catalog features a variety of fingerprint-based items, including access terminals, secure door locks, universal serial bus (USB) readers, and original equipment manufacturer (OEM) modules. The company also offers radio frequency (RF) smart card terminals, people-counting systems, and proprietary software. Furthermore, their offerings encompass solutions for fingerprint-secured personal computer logins and full high-definition video recorders. Founded by Yo-Shik Shin on February 29, 2000, the firm's main office is located in Seoul, South Korea.
